Adapted to lumina5 conventions after a principal-level plan review. Key deviations from a naive apply: (1) dispatch reuses the existing useChatInput.programmaticSubmit Zustand channel (added a sibling programmaticLaunch payload) instead of a new CustomEvent module -- DOM-free, race-hardened, far less invasive; (2) required-tools are passed PER-MESSAGE via a new toolsOverride on handleSendClick (no sticky LLMContext save/restore race), and an unsupported tool refuses the send with a structured toast rather than degrading; (3) visibilityScopes maps to the existing user.tags entitlement model; (4) 'hidden' execution mode is DESCOPED (reserved in the enum, treated as auto-fire) -- the host send path has no server-side hidden-message support yet; follow-up needed; (5) dead display flags (suppressAuxiliaryPanels/stripIntroductoryProse) omitted -- no render surface; (6) compound indexes {userId,deletedAt}/{userId,type,deletedAt}/{userId,tags,deletedAt} with type+tags in separate indexes (multikey rule); (7) API-key callers are denied personal prompts (confused-deputy) and admin bypass is isAdmin && !apiKey; (8) seed migration ships starter system prompts + minimal personal-prompt CRUD API (authoring UI deferred). Feature-gated behind EnableBriefcase (default off). Module-singleton nonce dedup + single-flight with watchdog. Guard hardening: zero-width/bidi strip, role-delimiter denylist, id-shape rejection, length cap, signal-on-trigger. Substitution is single-pass with the function-form replace.

Pre-existing implementation, recorded retroactively. This repo is the source the artifact-publishing amendments were extracted from, so these files were studied rather than generated. Satisfied by the existing origin-isolation implementation. Verified against the advisory's own checklist rather than assumed: a distinct bundle-origin host helper paired with a wrapper-host predicate that excludes it, an opaque-origin srcdoc sandbox carrying no allow-same-origin on the gated path, no nonce anywhere in the serve path, an argument-free bootstrap shell, and no credentialed CORS grant reflecting bundle origins. The cross-origin src path does carry allow-same-origin, which is correct rather than a violation: the frame's origin there is the isolated per-artifact host, not the app's, so same-origin means same as the isolated origin. A naive repo-wide grep for allow-same-origin reads as a failure here and is the wrong test; the advisory's criterion is scoped to the gated path.

Pattern transfer for LibreOncology pathway pages (rehypeRaw-FREE variant -- the libonc boundary guard forbids rehype-raw; markers are split out of mdast text nodes so code is structurally exempt). Manifest construction adapted to the existing engine: a new generic session field citationStyle (named|indexed, EXTRACTION.md §3 procedure: SessionTypes doc-comment + zod + mongoose enum) makes KnowledgeRetrievalFeature number each distinct retrieved document in the injected context and emit the index-only prompt fragment; quest.promptMeta.citables order IS the manifest order ([N] => citables[N-1]) and the existing quest persistence + poll is the ManifestTransport seam (no version field -- pre-existing wire shape). Layer-1 index verification + cited-only first-appearance reindex run CLIENT-side (prepareCitedReply) before parsing, with a graceful no-marker fallback for legacy v1 sessions; pathway surface key bumped to v2 so modules regenerate indexed. invalidIndices is surfaced for the Phase F fabrication-flag pipeline (REVIEW_PIPELINE §7) but no hot-path server post-processing step (would wedge libonc logic into the core reply path). DESCOPED as inert for this consumer: layer-2 URL liveness + the whole SSRF UrlLivenessClient (manifest sources are internal lake documents; web tools disabled on website sessions; render-time URL-scheme allowlist IS implemented in isSafeExternalHref), stripReferenceSections (prompt structure + indexed addendum forbid reference sections), mid-turn tool-source index merging (tool-retrieved citables append unnumbered -- model cannot cite them, reindex hides them; known v1 limit).

Integrated into ModalModel as the primary content type for audience-personalized What's New modals. Key adaptations: (1) lumina5 has no org model -- classifier uses user.tags.includes('internal') rather than an org-level isInternal DB flag; no TTL cache / index needed since the tag is already loaded by the auth middleware with no additional DB round-trip (the blueprint's cache-invalidation / TTL-downgrade / classifier-index hardening is therefore N/A here); (2) ILuminaViewerContext extends IViewerContext with userTags: string[] -- classify is synchronous; (3) IModal and ModalSchema add variants: Partial<Record<string, VariantContent>> | null using Schema.Types.Mixed; (4) /api/modals/index.ts: classify viewer -> extractVariantForViewer on every doc -> filter nulls; fail-open to 'customer' at the call site, now logged (fail-open observability); (5) generationMetadata pre-existed on ModalModel -- stripped by extractVariantForViewer without schema changes. Second pass (un-descopes earlier 6 & 7, adds the generation expansion from blueprint PR #52): (6) admin raw-variants authoring endpoint added at apps/client/pages/api/admin/modals/variants.ts -- admin-gated (ensureAdmin), never applies the leak guard (GET returns the raw variants map, PUT replaces it, DELETE clears it); (7) generation-time per-variant scoping wired into the existing What's New worker -- one scoped LLM call per AUDIENCE_VARIANTS key (buildVariantGuidance), NO_USER_FACING_CHANGES empty-result sentinel reused, per-variant outcome metering (VariantSuccess/NoChanges/Failed), and all variants persisted in one atomic ModalModel.create. The customer (least-privileged) variant gates the modal and is the scrubbed top-level base; internal falls back to the customer floor when absent. (8) ScrubInternalReferences seam added to AudienceVariantTypes.ts; scrubInternalReferences/scrubVariantContent applied to customer output as the write-side leak defense -- DEFAULT_INTERNAL_REFERENCE_RULES seeded with repo/org tokens and PUBLIC_PRODUCT_NAME='Bike4Mind' (TODO: confirm against brand config; scrub-verification test enforces the denylist). Adapted to lumina5 after auditing the repo's real PR data rather than adopting the blueprint's example taxonomy. Key decisions: (1) TAXONOMY replaced with 19 buckets derived from labels actually in use on Bike4Mind/bike4mind (release/draft shortCircuit; qaInProgress/awaitingTesting/qaClarification testing; qaFailed/mergeConflict/awaitingFix/onHold/dependencies/inProgress standalone; changeRequest/awaitingSpecialReview/awaitingReview/reviewOngoing/readyForMerge reviewGate; approvedAwaitingAuthor reroute; approved generic; none catchAll). mergeConflict is ordered AHEAD of readyForMerge so a conflicted qa_passed PR reads as blocked, not ready. (2) QA BUCKETS USE mention:'owner', NOT roleRoster+assignee — 35 of 36 open PRs have the author as first assignee (all 8 QA-labelled ones included), so an assignee-gated roster would be permanently stuck shut: pool never tagged, every line pinging the developer, inside sections whose purpose is nudging QA. base.md prescribes mention:'owner' exactly for this case. The RENDERER still implements the assignee-roster path and buildReport.test.ts asserts both gate directions for it, so flipping QA to roleRoster is a spec-only change once PRs are reassigned as work transfers. Review gates keep roleRoster+requestedReviewer (populated on 14/36, so that gate genuinely opens and closes). (3) GENERATE BUDGET sized for the platform per base.md's second remedy: the Next.js server is an SST sst.aws.Nextjs Lambda (server.timeout 60s) behind a CloudFront Router, NOT API Gateway, so there is no 29s integration cap — but the CDN origin-response ceiling is lower than the Lambda's, so the budget is 25s over all three round-trips and the page walk is bounded at 2x100=200 (steady state ~36) rather than sized to the repo. Page walk sorts created/ASC so truncation sheds the FRESHEST PRs, base.md's preferred benign drop order. (4) ChatPostTarget is bot-token+channel, not an incoming webhook, specifically so FetchChatMemberNames has a user-lookup read scope and the proofreading preview shows real names instead of raw member ids. (5) DELIBERATELY BYPASSES SlackClient (b4m-core/slack), the repo's usual Slack entry point, for two disqualifying behaviours: sendMessage collapses every failure into null, which cannot express the notDelivered-vs-unknown distinction the dedupe release rule turns on; and MAX_TEXT_LENGTH is 4000 with silent safeTruncate, so a ~36-PR digest would post cut off mid-section while reading as complete. slackChatTarget.ts drives @slack/web-api WebClient directly, classifies failures into PostDelivery (PlatformError/RateLimited/4xx => notDelivered; 5xx/ECONNRESET/timeouts/anything unrecognized => unknown, so unclassified holds), and never truncates. (6) DEDUPE STORE is the shared Mongo Cache collection, NOT NotificationDeduplicator from @bike4mind/utils, which is an in-process Map — exactly the correctness trap base.md names. cacheRepository already had an atomic put-if-absent holding a value (claimDedup); added readDedup + casUpdateDedup + casDeleteDedup (compare-and-set / compare-and-delete on result.ownerToken) to ICacheRepository and CacheModel, because put-if-absent plus blind writes lets a stale submit clobber a newer reservation. readDedup treats an expired-but-unswept doc as absent (Mongo TTL lag ~60s). (7) SSRF guard assertRepoFormat is deliberately STRICTER than GitHubService's internal parseRepo, whose per-segment class permits '.' and therefore accepts a literal '..' segment; guards.test.ts pins that case. (8) EGRESS GUARD validates the Slack API origin against the operator-configured allowlist rather than treating a URL-less bot-token target as an automatic pass — otherwise this consumer's only egress would go unchecked and the allowlist would be decorative. Fails closed on an empty allowlist; messages name the failed check and never echo the target. (9) githubService.ts gained listOpenPullRequests (bounded page walk, always populates requested_reviewers as an array so 'absent is not empty' holds), searchApprovedPullRequestNumbers (one repo-wide review:approved search), and GitHubRateLimitedError carrying retryAfterSeconds/resetAt. listOpenPullRequests THROWS on a disallowed repo instead of returning [] like its siblings — an empty array would render as a complete digest reporting zero open PRs. (10) OBSERVABILITY is structured log lines with a stable `metric` field for CloudWatch metric filters (PrReportMetricName covers all seven degradations). (11) AUDIT is a structured req.logger line with the acting identity rather than logAuditEvent, which keys on a registered analytics event union — adding a family would mean touching the analytics payload registry. FOLLOW-UP if this endpoint gains a compliance requirement. (12) Settings live in settingsMap: prReportRepo, prReportIdentityMap, prReportSlackChannel, prReportEgressAllowlist. (13) One cosmetic consequence of the contract: BucketSpec.order drives both precedence and render order, so the shortCircuit sections (Release, Drafts) print first. NOTE: @bike4mind/services is consumed via built dist — rerun its build after touching prReportService source. 127 new tests; client typecheck and eslint clean.
